scope: all video platforms and all generated-video renderers
rule: An issue is closed only when root cause, production fix, failing regression test, and final artifact evidence are all bound. A Kuaishou-only sample cannot close an all-platform issue.

issues.problem: outer composition repeats top title, middle panel, bottom subtitle
issues.root_cause: template identity and background changes were treated as structural diversity
production_fix: scripts/visual_contract_gate.py: semantic DOM signatures and public_shell_overuse
missing_closure: all generated-video renderers must emit comparable structure fingerprints
cross-platform recent-work ledger must reject repeated fingerprints

issues.problem: business visual ROI is too small relative to empty space
issues.root_cause: DOM presence was mistaken for visible semantic area
production_fix: scripts/visual_contract_gate.py: browser-computed visible_area_ratio
missing_closure: threshold must be platform-profile aware
final MP4 pixel evidence must confirm ROI after composition

issues.problem: CTA exists only in subtitles or narration rather than as an independent visual object
issues.root_cause: script CTA and visual CTA were not separate delivery objects
production_fix: content_platform/generation_quality_contract.py validates CTA semantics
scripts/visual_contract_gate.py requires a browser-computed independent visible CTA object when the quality contract is active
missing_closure: all platform runners must enable the quality-contract CTA check
G3/G6 must verify CTA pixels, collision, OCR, and safe-zone visibility

issues.problem: end-card explanatory copy overlaps labels, repeats information, or lacks contrast
issues.root_cause: layout collision and local contrast were not checked in final pixels
production_fix: scripts/visual_contract_gate.py: browser-computed visual-role geometry collision, local contrast ratio, and semantic-key duplicate checks
missing_closure: all generated-video renderers must emit visual-role and semantic-key markers
final MP4/PNG pixel evidence must bind collision and contrast results
OCR/text-layer comparison must cover unmarked legacy renderer output

issues.problem: background is visually attractive but semantically inappropriate
issues.root_cause: background provenance and existence were checked without a mandatory claim-to-asset semantic decision
production_fix: content_platform/generation_quality_contract.py: validate_asset_semantic_contract
content_platform/video_generation_contract.py: validate and persist asset_semantic_contract when supplied
missing_closure: all platform runners must produce the contract before asset/render work
VLM or equivalent evidence must bind each beat claim to background and evidence asset
final candidate evidence must include the exact asset decision and artifact hashes

issues.problem: continuous bidirectional background or full-canvas drift causes discomfort
issues.root_cause: aggregate motion was rewarded while motion location, direction reversal, and duration were ignored
production_fix: content_platform/video_artifact.py spatial motion evidence and transition-burst exclusion
missing_closure: all renderers and platform routes must invoke the same final-candidate spatial gate
direction-reversal regression must use the rejected attempt-2 artifact

issues.problem: single-frame white flash or short black gap escapes sparse contact-sheet review
issues.root_cause: sparse frame sampling was used as a substitute for full-frame luminance analysis
production_fix: final-candidate all-frame luminance evidence in current film renderer path
missing_closure: verify every generated-video renderer routes through the same all-frame gate
bind failure injection fixtures for one-frame white and black anomalies

issues.problem: cover contract defects are discovered after expensive video composition
issues.root_cause: generated cover evidence omitted SHA and semantic fields and cover validation ran too late
production_fix: scripts/video_toolchain_runner.py writes SHA-bound generated cover evidence
scripts/gen_cover.py omits empty secondary focal nodes
missing_closure: cover contract and low-resolution cover candidate gate must run before full video render for every platform

issues.problem: run directory, revision, attempt_id, and trusted manifest disagree
production_fix: content_platform/video_generation_contract.py derives and validates one attempt identity
missing_closure: cross-platform entrypoint matrix must prove every runner uses compile_generation_contract

issues.problem: small subtitle or scene changes trigger unnecessary full rerenders
issues.root_cause: cache invalidation granularity was final-video wide
production_fix: scripts/film_renderer.py layered invalidation and scene cache recheck
missing_closure: shared cache ABI for non-film renderers
performance manifest proving hit, miss, invalidation reason, encode and decode counts

issues.problem: automatic HANDOFF_READY survives a later user visual NO_GO
issues.root_cause: technical release state was treated as stronger than final human visual verdict
production_fix: attempt-1 and attempt-2 rejection evidence records delivery_allowed=false
content_platform/media.py validates user_visual_rejection.json identity and artifact SHA and rejects NO_GO before accepting HANDOFF_READY
final_evidence: real attempt-2 validation returns RuntimeError: user NO_GO supersedes HANDOFF_READY
missing_closure: publisher scripts that bypass MediaBridge must call the same trusted-candidate guard
the manifest state itself should gain an atomic SUPERSEDED_BY_USER state rather than retaining stale HANDOFF_READY bytes

issues.problem: targeted test success is reported as repository-wide success
issues.root_cause: verification scope was not persisted with the result
production_fix: content_platform/verification_manifest.py
data/verification/latest-targeted.json
missing_closure: verification manifest must record command, selected files, counts, failures, and scope=targeted|full
completion reporting must read this manifest

issues.problem: complete-work latency cannot be verified against the 30-minute target
issues.root_cause: stage timing, cache, render, encode, decode, and review costs are not emitted in one cross-platform manifest
production_fix: content_platform/performance_aggregate.py
content_platform/performance_manifest.py
scripts/video_toolchain_runner.py
missing_closure: cross-platform performance_manifest
P50/P80 aggregation
quality-preserving SLA classification
